description: Hand-labelled pairs to validate the faithfulness judge BEFORE trusting its scores. Each pair is a real knowledge-base chunk (by chunk_id) and a sentence a draft might contain. supported=true only if the chunk alone backs every claim in the sentence. Unsupported cases include changed numbers, invented conditions, wrong plan names, and two real failures seen in this project: the invented '30 days, whichever is later' refund rule (Phase 5) and the Android cache path given to a Samsung TV user (Phase 6).
